game.zero.title: Game Zero
mirror.control.not_allowlisted: Query {name!r} is not on the MirrorWeave allow-list; the drive_studio capability only runs read-only queries.
lens.pillow_missing: Decoding JPEG/WebP needs Pillow (install forge with the 'lens' extra); the image was not assessed.
depth.no_intrinsics: Cannot derive the focal length in pixels: give focal_length_mm with sensor_width_mm, or focal_length_35mm, or a horizontal field of view.
depth.bad_anchors: Metric alignment needs at least two anchors with distinct relative-depth values and positive distances.
depth.non_monotone: The fitted scale is not positive: the relative depth map disagrees with the anchors (wrong map polarity or bad anchors).
recon.no_gpu_node: No cluster node advertises {device}; the splat job cannot be placed (gpu_required, route loomcluster).
recon.too_few_views: Capture set has {have} usable views; mode {mode} needs at least {need}.
recon.eta.gpu: tens of minutes to hours on a ROCm/CUDA node (unmeasured; depends on views and resolution)
recon.eta.cpu: hours on CPU only (spec §7 'CPU room capture can be hours'; unmeasured here)
recon.eta.none: no runnable route on the available devices
mirror.video.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg was not found (set FORGE_FFMPEG or install it). MirrorWeave video and desktop capture use the system ffmpeg; they are never faked.
mirror.video.cpu_codec: CPU video encoding supports vp8 and vp9 (libvpx); {codec} is not a CPU encoder here (H.264 is encoded on the phone's hardware).
mirror.video.unsupported_codec: Codec {codec} is not supported by MirrorWeave (use vp8, vp9 or h264).
mirror.capture.no_display: No X11 display to capture: set DISPLAY (or --display). Windows/Wayland desktop capture is not wired.
mirror.capture.android_only: Phone screen capture runs on the phone (MediaProjection); on the desktop, frames arrive through a paired LoomLink FrameHub.
mirror.input.need_device: Desktop-to-phone input needs the LoomLink state dir and a paired device id.
mirror.control.android_local_only: Phone input and camera focus are queued only by the desktop operator (forge mirror input), never relayed from another device.
mirror.studio.no_sink: No Studio input sink is attached to this LoomLink server.
mirror.studio.key_not_allowed: Key {name!r} is not on the Studio input allow-list.
studio.title: AssetFabric Studio
studio.mirror.empty: No mirrored frame yet — pair a phone with forge link serve and start mirroring.
studio.console.placeholder: Type here — remote Studio input from a paired phone lands here. Plain text is echoed; /help lists the read-only commands.
depth.ort_missing: Dense depth needs onnxruntime: install the `depth` extra (pip install -e '.[depth]').
recon.splat.cpu_too_large: CPU splat training is bounded to tiny scenes ({splats} splats, {width} px, {views} views requested; limits {max_splats} splats, {max_w} px, {max_views} views). Larger scenes need the GPU trainer (recon.splat, route loomcluster).
recon.splat.sfm_failed: CPU SfM could not pose the capture for splat training ({registered} views registered, {points} points); need at least 3 views and 20 points.
studio.slash.help: Read-only commands: /status · /models · /palettes · /intent <command text> · /help. Nothing here writes files or runs a shell.
studio.persona.note: Micro-LM drafts for review only — Studio writes nothing; use `forge persona author --write` to queue drafts (reviewed: false).
stub.recon.splat_submit: Submitting a reconstruction to the cluster (or from the phone) is not wired: LoomCluster has no `recon.splat` worker op yet, so nothing is queued. Run the trainer on the ROCm node itself: `forge recon train --stage splat <bundle>` (external OpenSplat, real_unverified_on_gpu); the tiny-scene CPU rung is `--stage splat-cpu`.
recon.splat.gpu.no_device: Full-scale splat training needs a ROCm GPU on this host (GroundWeave devices: {devices}). Run it on the fleet's ROCm node, or use `--stage splat-cpu` (tiny scenes) / `forge recon photogrammetry` (CPU route).
recon.splat.gpu.no_trainer: No 3DGS trainer found: install OpenSplat (ROCm/HIP build, AGPL-3.0, not bundled) so `opensplat` is on PATH, or set {env} / --trainer-cmd to a command template using {{data}} {{out}} {{iters}} {{sh_degree}} {{downscale}} {{seed}}.
recon.splat.gpu.bad_config: Splat training config out of range (iters {iters}: 1–1000000; SH degree {sh}: 1–3; downscale {downscale}: 1–16).
recon.splat.gpu.bad_image: Capture view is neither PNG nor JPEG; the trainer project cannot include it.
recon.splat.gpu.timeout: The splat trainer did not finish within {seconds} s and was stopped; no output was kept.
recon.splat.gpu.trainer_failed: The splat trainer exited with code {code}: {tail}
recon.splat.gpu.no_output: The splat trainer exited cleanly but wrote no {path}.
recon.splat.gpu.bad_output: The splat trainer's output was rejected: {why}
recon.splat.gpu.probe_note: Contract probe on CPU: the exported project was checked and a valid .ply was written from the sparse points. Nothing was trained; this is not a reconstruction.
recon.splat.gpu.unverified_note: Trained by the external trainer; output validated. This path has not been verified on an AMD GPU by AssetFabric (real_unverified_on_gpu); GPU output is not bit-reproducible.
